messages.subject: dcar_normal
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am new user for nimble package.

I wrote the code which is attached below, but I got an error.

GWRCode <- nimbleCode({
  for (i in 1:S) {
    y[1:N, i] ~ dmnorm(mu_y[1:N, i], prec = tau_y0[1:N, 1:N, i])
    mu_y[1:N, i] <-  b[i, 1] * x1[1:N] + b[i, 2] * x2[1:N] + b[i, 3] *
      x3[1:N] + b[i, 4] * x4[1:N]+ b[i, 5] * x5[1:N]+ b[i, 6] * x6[1:N] +b[i, 7] * x7[1:N]+b[i, 8] * x8[1:N]+
      b[i, 9] * x9[1:N]+ b[i, 10] * x10[1:N]+ b[i, 11] * x11[1:N]+ b[i, 12] * x12[1:N]+ s[1:N,i]
    tau_y0[1:N, 1:N, i] <- diag(psi_y[i] * exp(-Dist[1:N, i]/lambda))
    for (j in 1:12) {
      b[i, j] ~ dnorm(0, 100)
    }
    psi_y[i] ~ dgamma(1, 1)
    s[1:N,i] ~ dcar_normal(adj[1:L], weights[1:L], num[1:N], tau,zero_mean=1)
    }
  lambda ~ dunif(0, D)
  tau ~ dgamma(0.001, 0.001)
 
})


nb <- poly2nb(QLD_SA2_SHP, queen=TRUE)
nb[1]
adj_mat <- nb2mat(poly2nb(QLD_SA2_SHP), style = "B",zero.policy=TRUE)
adj_mat[1:10, 1:10]
library(nimble)
dat<- as.carAdjacency(adj_mat)


GWRData <- list(N=526,y = y, x1 = ScaledPreschool, x2 = ScaledEnglish, x3 = ScaledIndigenous, x4 =ScaledAus ,
                x5 = remote2,x6 = remote3,x7 = remote4,x8 = remote5,x9 = IRSD2,x10 = IRSD3,
                x11 = IRSD4,x12 = IRSD5,Dist = dist_mat_2,num = dat$num, weights = dat$weights,
                adj = dat$adj )

GWRConst <- list(S=526, N=526,L=2698, D = 50,num = dat$num, weights = dat$weights,
                 adj = dat$adj)

GWRInits <- list(psi_y = rep(1, GWRConst$S), lambda = 10,tau = 1, s=rep(0,GWRConst$S))

mcmc.out <- nimbleMCMC(code = GWRCode,  constants = GWRConst,data = GWRData,
                       inits = GWRInits, thin = 1, niter = 5000, nchains = 1, nburnin = 2000,
                       monitors = c("b", "psi_y", "lambda"), setSeed = TRUE)



Defining model
Error in addMissingIndexingRecurse(code[[i]], dimensionsList) :  inconsistent dimensionality provided for node 's'

is there any suggestion?

Thanks

messages.author: 9b1f1220a2b07d1e
messages.subject: Re: dcar_normal
parts:
Hi there,

I'm seeing that in the model code, "s" is a matrix with dimensions N x S. But in inits, you provide an initial value for "s" that's a vector, i.e. 1 x S. Try initializing "s" with a matrix of 0s, such as matrix(0, nrow = N, ncol = S)

Hope this helps--
Ben
